auth.why: To act on the user's medical bills: read bill/EOB details you provide, generate dispute letters, and collect the contingency fee only when you confirm a reduction.

description: Spots errors in medical bills and EOBs in about a minute — duplicates, bill-vs-EOB mismatches, possible balance billing, unbundling heuristics. Builds dispute letter packs. Contingency: 25% of the bill reduction you confirm, charged only then.

proactive_triggers.description: Hospital/provider bill or EOB email detected in Gmail
proactive_triggers.nudge: That $4,200 ER bill just landed. 8 in 10 medical bills have errors, and I spot them in seconds. Want me to check yours? One tap.

tools.description: Start the conversational bill check — one question at a time, the golden path

prefill.description: Any known fields: patient_name, provider_name, bill_date, total

tools.name: start_bill_check

tools.description: Answer the current bill-check question; detection runs when the last one is answered
tools.name: answer_question

tools.description: Open a case from structured bill/EOB data (for agents that already have it)
tools.name: create_case

tools.description: Get a case with its intake, findings, and outcome
tools.name: get_case

tools.description: Record the user-confirmed bill reduction; computes the 25% fee
tools.name: report_outcome

tools.description: Create the Stripe customer + SetupIntent; returns the exact fee terms before any card is saved
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Charge 25% of the confirmed reduction off-session against the saved card
tools.name: confirm_reduction_charge
